component.name: Rapid Installer
component.summary: Universal Package Installer & GTK Application Manager for Linux

description.p: Rapid Installer brings a macOS-style graphical desktop application manager and seamless package deployment experience to Ubuntu, Debian, and Linux platforms.

It automatically extracts and deploys .deb, .tar.gz, .zip, .AppImage, .rpm, and .7z software packages into user-space (~/.local/opt/) without requiring sudo or root permissions. Features include live progress spinners, smart binary heuristic entry-point scanning, FreeDesktop desktop shortcut creation, AppCleaner-style deep uninstallation, and developer toolchain management.

screenshot.caption: Rapid Installer GTK Application Manager Dashboard

description.p: Initial release v1.0.0 featuring GTK3 App Manager, automated package extraction, and GNOME trusted shortcut integration.
